entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: None of these posts are any good.[n]Everyone's just bitchin' about their[n]parents or their boyfriends.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: There ain't even a hint of a hint about[n]a new Palace...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We can't get everything online...[n]Finding a post with a name and[n]location is asking a lot...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Guess we just gotta find one ourselves[n]then!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Are you seriously suggesting we look[n]for a target that even the police have[n]overlooked?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Yeah, you're right. We should prolly just[n]hold off 'til exams are done with, huh?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We can wait and see for a little longer,[n]then worry about comin' up empty-[n]handed if it happens...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: This place is off-limits, you know.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...We'll get outta here once we're done[n]chattin'.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Anyways, what's Miss Council President[n]want with us?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: The troublemaker, the center of gossip,[n]and the infamous transfer student.[n]Hmm, interesting combination.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Great way to start a conversation...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: By the way...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It seems as though you got to know[n]Mr. Kamoshida pretty well.
Somewhat.
Not really.
Who?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Anyone who attends this school would[n]have interacted with him, whether they[n]liked it or not.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah, y'know he's only been here[n]a month or so.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Are you playing dumb with me?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It just goes to show how little interaction[n]he had with him.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hm...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I heard Mr. Kamoshida used a volleyball[n]team member to spread details of your[n]past record.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Don't you hate him? Mr. Kamoshida,[n]I mean.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What's all this about?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: My friend here's an upstanding guy.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I don't mean to offend. Many students[n]have been shaken up by what happened[n]with Mr. Kamoshida.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: The rumors about that odd, calling[n]card-esque posting aren't going away[n]either.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I didn't expect someone like you[n]would care about that tactless stuff,[n]Niijima-senpai.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I dunno that it was tactless...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Anyways, we done here? We can't leave[n]if you keep talkin' to us.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: At least try to understand my position.[n]Being forced to deal with this horseplay...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Horseplay!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Ah yes, by the way... It's been decided[n]that this place will be closed off due to[n]the incident.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I heard some people are coming up here[n]without permission, after all.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...I'm sorry to have interrupted you.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What was that about?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...She's on to us.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That girl seems rather sharp. We should[n]be cautious of her.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: She really pisses me off!
Be careful.
She's figured us out...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Talk about a pain in the ass...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Talk about a pain in the ass...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That reminds me...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Study hard. Especially you, Ryuji. There[n]are bound to be traps that will need to[n]be solved with brains.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Keep in mind that everything you do in[n]your daily lives has an impact on your[n]abilities.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: True, studying won't be so bad if we just[n]think of it as helping us prepare to be[n]phantom thieves...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I guess you got a point...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But man, it's just so lame... I was all[n]fired up about helpin' people, not[n]about studyin'...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, I do have somewhere interesting[n]to show you beforehand.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You guys did originally promise to help[n]me out with my mission, after all.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Huh? Mission?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Follow me.
